scope_limitations: I checked codepoints by reading the text visually through the Read tool. I could not see raw codepoint dumps, so I'm assuming the usual encodings: U+05BD for silluq/meteg, U+0599 for pashta, U+059B for tevir, U+05A5 for merkha, U+05A3 for munach, U+05A4 for mahpakh, U+0594 for zaqef qatan, U+0596 for tipcha and U+0591 for etnahta.
